title: Jane Eyre
author: Charlotte Brontë
description: An orphaned governess seeks independence, love and integrity.
rights: Source edition: public domain in the United States. Listed creative contributors screened for India, UK and EU; original licence retained.
longDescription: Atmosphere matters as much as action: unsettling places, uncertainty and emotional intensity shape the experience. Questions of trust, belonging and the limits of human understanding give the story resonance beyond its suspense. Read for the gradually deepening mood without needing to know its surprises in advance.

authorInfo.bio: Charlotte Nicholls, commonly known by her maiden name Charlotte Brontë, was an English novelist and poet, and was the elder sister of Emily, Anne and Branwell Brontë. She is best known for her novel Jane Eyre, which was first published under the pseudonym Currer Bell. Jane Eyre was a great success on publication, and has since been acknowledged as a classic of English literature.
